- Finn is at least 3 apart from both Cara and Elif.
- Ben and Ivo at least 3 apart.

- Ann at 3, Hana at 9 → 6 apart, at least 3. ✅
- Gus at 8 before Hana at 9. ✅
- Ann at 3 before Elif at 5. ✅
- Finn at 2 before Ben at 4. ✅
- Elif at 5 before Gus at 8. ✅
- Cara at 7 and Finn at 2 → 5 apart, at least 3. ✅
- Elif at 5 and Finn at 2 → 3 apart. ✅
- Ivo at 1 before Ann at 3. ✅
- Cara at 7 immediately after Dev at 6. ✅
- Ben at 4 before Dev at 6. ✅

So the schedule works.
